map.summary: This document is a datasheet for the DM7408, a quad 2-input AND-gate device. It identifies the DM7408N ordering code and 14-lead, 0.300-inch-wide PDIP package (N14A), and provides the logic equation and truth table: the output is HIGH only when both inputs are HIGH. It specifies absolute maximum voltage and temperature ratings, while cautioning that these are stress limits rather than normal operating conditions or guaranteed performance limits. Recommended operation uses a 4.75–5.25 V supply, specified HIGH and LOW input levels, output-current limits, and a 0–70 °C free-air temperature range. Electrical tables cover input clamp voltage and currents, output HIGH and LOW voltages, short-circuit output current, and supply current. Switching characteristics give LOW-to-HIGH and HIGH-to-LOW propagation delays under stated test conditions. The document also includes the PDIP dimension drawing and Fairchild’s general product-use disclaimer, including restrictions on use in life-support systems without written approval.
map.short_description: Datasheet covering DM7408 logic, operating limits, electrical data, timing, package, and use restrictions.

sections.title: Device Overview, Ordering, and Logic Function
sections.summary: Identifies the DM7408 as a device containing four independent 2-input AND gates. Lists the DM7408N ordering code and its 14-lead PDIP package, then gives the logic equation and truth table: the output is LOW unless both inputs are HIGH.
sections.short_description: Introduces the DM7408, its package option, and its AND-gate truth table.

sections.title: Absolute Maximum Ratings
sections.summary: Provides absolute maximum supply and input voltages, operating free-air temperature, and storage temperature limits. The note cautions that these are not normal operating conditions or guaranteed parametric limits; device operation should instead follow the recommended operating conditions.
sections.short_description: Lists maximum voltage and temperature limits and explains their meaning.

sections.title: Recommended Operating Conditions
sections.summary: Gives recommended conditions for using the DM7408: a 4.75–5.25 V supply, minimum HIGH and maximum LOW input levels, output-current limits, and a 0–70 °C free-air operating range. The following section introduces electrical characteristics over the recommended temperature range.
sections.short_description: Specifies the recommended supply, input, output-current, and temperature ranges.

sections.title: Electrical Characteristics
sections.summary: Tabulates electrical limits for input clamp voltage, HIGH and LOW output voltage, input currents, short-circuit output current, and supply current with outputs HIGH or LOW. Notes that typical values apply at a 5 V supply and 25 °C, and that only one output should be shorted at a time.
sections.short_description: Reports input, output, short-circuit, and supply-current characteristics.

sections.title: Switching Characteristics and Package Dimensions
sections.summary: Lists propagation delay measurements at 5 V and 25 °C, including LOW-to-HIGH and HIGH-to-LOW output transitions under specified load conditions. The section then identifies the physical-dimensions drawing as the 14-lead, 0.300-inch-wide PDIP, package N14A.
sections.short_description: Gives propagation delays and identifies the package drawing for the PDIP.

sections.title: Disclaimer and Life Support Policy
sections.summary: Provides Fairchild’s disclaimer concerning use of described circuitry, implied patent licenses, and changes to specifications. The life-support policy prohibits use of products as critical components in life-support devices or systems without written approval, and defines those systems and critical components.
sections.short_description: States product-use disclaimers and restrictions for life-support applications.
